title: Ex-Warrior Kevin Durant Dubs Drake The G.O.A.T & Drake Drops Tracklist To 'Nevermind'
htmlContent:
Earlier this month, Hot New Hip Hop reported after a new snippet of music was leaked on Tik Tok featuring Drake hinted that he was in summer mode and foreshadowed that an album might be on the way.

It turns out they were spot on earlier today; Drake shared on Instagram that he planned to drop an album at midnight called' "Honesty, Nevermind."

It did not take long for former Golden State Warriors forward Kevin Durant to respond to the news in his Instagram Story with the messages, 'G.O.A.T. back."

not too long after Durant's message on Instagram, Drake hopped back on IG and dropped the cover art for the new project.

Last season, Durant compared his game to Drake's song Crew love stating, “Crew Love by Drake because obviously, you’re going to have a crew out there while you’re hooping. It’s a slower tempo song, and that’s the kind of and that’s the kind of pace I like to play it. So, it matches with, you know, my approach to the game.”

Drake actually shoutout his friend Durant in a verse.

“A lot of people just hit me up when my name is mentioned / Shout-out to KD, we relate, we get the same attention / It’s rainin’ money, Oklahoma City Thunder / The most successful rapper 35 and under.”

Speaking of Golden State, they are looking to clutch their four championships in eight years tonight against the Boston Celtics in game six in Boston.
